_comment: Ported 2026-09-16 from the source project. families_by_page_type scopes which invariant families run per page type. IMG/LAYOUT/NAV are BLOCKING; SEM/SCHEMA/CSS/DUP/A11Y/FORM enter ADVISORY until they have passed their fixtures AND produced zero false reports across one full cluster - the same promotion rule the source harness uses. Registering a check is not wiring it in: in the source project the A11Y family was registered and declared blocking a full day before it appeared here, so it examined ZERO pages while reporting as a shipped gate (Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs is what caught it). meta.spec.ts now asserts the symmetric difference between registered families and families named here is empty. DUP's sibling set is every built page (lib/dupCorpus.ts siblingSlugsFor), never 'targets of the same page type', so no page type compares against nothing. Foundation is a verbatim migration of WordPress markup: many failures are expected on migrated bodies and form the baseline for projects 3 and 4; failures caused by the shell (SiteHeader/SiteFooter/Breadcrumb/BaseLayout/PuppyList/ContactForm) are fixed here. `corpus: true` marks the frozen benchmark sample - one page per page type - so the quality trend does not depend on which pages happened to be built that month.
_deferred_comment: Controller decision 2026-09-16. These checks are registered, wired and passing their fixture pairs, but the convention they encode does not exist on Foundation's verbatim WordPress markup, so they examine zero nodes on every built page. Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs exempts them from the zero-examined FAIL and PRINTS them as DEFERRED with the reason, so the scorecard is never silent about them. meta.spec.ts asserts every id here is a registered check that still passes both fixtures AND that it examined zero nodes in the latest raw run, so a deferral can never hide a dead check nor outlive the condition that justified it. Every rationale must end with its promotion condition ('remove this entry when ...').

deferred_checks.layout-hero-counter-separation: BSUK has no counter strip until project 3 adopts the kit; deferred 2026-09-16. Remove this entry when any built page ships a counter strip, i.e. when the scorecard shows this check examining more than zero nodes.
deferred_checks.layout-h3-image-first: no H3-owned .sec-img convention on migrated WordPress bodies; adopted in project 3. Remove this entry when project 3 re-authors bodies so an H3 owns its .sec-img, i.e. when the scorecard shows this check examining more than zero nodes.
deferred_checks.sem-statement-label-visible: no .stmt-label convention yet; adopted in project 3. Remove this entry when the kit introduces .stmt-label, i.e. when the scorecard shows this check examining more than zero nodes.
